vehicle.tab.label: Vehicles
vehicle.tab.title: Vehicle heatmap: the hits on one vehicle type, painted on its figure
vehicle.panel.title: Vehicle heatmap
vehicle.empty.title: Vehicle heatmap
vehicle.empty.noData: Load a match with hits on vehicles - a War Thunder replay converted by the War Thunder converter, or a CS2 demo table with hit groups. Drop the files here or use the source panel.
vehicle.empty.noHits: The loaded data has no hits with a place on the vehicle. War Thunder: convert the replay again with the current converter (it writes hitLocalX/Y/Z). CS2: a table with a hitgroup column.
vehicle.hint.unplaced: {n, plural, one {# hit has} other {# hits have}} no point on the vehicle: converted before the converter wrote one, or sent by the game in another frame.
vehicle.hint.regions: CS2 names the body part hit, not the point: each part is coloured by how often it was hit.
vehicle.layer.killsTitle: Only the hits by the killer in the last seconds before the vehicle died
vehicle.layer.modulesTitle: Destroyed modules, placed where the last hit before each landed
vehicle.colour.label: Colour points and arrows by
vehicle.pick.label: Vehicle
vehicle.counts: {hits, plural, one {# hit} other {# hits}}, {placed} on the figure, {fatal} killing
vehicle.sheet.title: Vehicle heatmap - six sides
vehicle.sheet.hint: {n, plural, one {# hit} other {# hits}}, every side at the same scale.
vehicle.sheet.sub: {layer}: {n, plural, one {# hit} other {# hits}} from {matches, plural, one {# match} other {# matches}}
vehicle.sheet.note: Made with 3DHeat. The figure is the viewer's own, not the game's model.
vehicle.look.title: Look
vehicle.look.exposureHint: 0 fills the ramp at the hottest few per cent of the surface; up shows faint hits, down tells hot spots apart.
vehicle.look.radiusHint: How far a hit's heat spreads over the surface (a Gaussian's radius). Auto is a fiftieth of the vehicle.
vehicle.look.fitTitle: The game's model has its origin where the game put it; the figure is built round its middle. Moves all of the vehicle's hits by one amount to where they lie best on the figure's surface.
vehicle.look.fitMoved: Hits moved {x} m forward, {y} m up, {z} m right.
vehicle.look.fitOff: Hits as the game sent them.
vehicle.look.arrowsTitle: An arrow for each hit, coming in the way the shot travelled
vehicle.sectors.title: Where the shots came from
vehicle.sectors.hint: By the side of the vehicle each shot came in from, in the vehicle's own frame.
vehicle.regions.title: Body parts hit
vehicle.region.head: Head
vehicle.modules.title: Destroyed modules
vehicle.modules.hint: The game sends a part number, not a name; the same number is the same part of the vehicle.
vehicle.filter.title: Filters
vehicle.hud.kills: {n, plural, one {# killing hit} other {# killing hits}}
vehicle.hud.modules: {n, plural, one {# destroyed module} other {# destroyed modules}}
vehicle.hud.none: No hits pass the filters ({n} before them).
